flag_name: a digital asset or the digital sector
definition: A digital asset or the digital sector: digital networks, hosting, platforms and systems, monitoring, warning and control systems, digital equipment and services, digital-sector policy and regulation, digital skills, and e-waste from digital equipment. Not digital: roads, buildings, energy access for households or non-digital facilities, agriculture, water, general institutional strengthening, or anything with no digital system, network, facility or equipment involved.

A policy instrument: a law, regulation, strategy, standard, code, guideline, institutional procedure or plan that governs behaviour beyond a single asset purchase. An investment is where the project builds, buys, installs, upgrades, operates or designs something; technical assistance to design or run a specific system is an investment, technical assistance to draft a regulation is policy.
